mapper.sql: payment_id, user_name, doc_number, room_amount, renta_mount, water_bill, electricity_bill, total_amount, payment_date, batch, payment_status, create_time, update_time
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM rentpayments
ORDER BY payment_status DESC, payment_date DESC, create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT FROM rentpayments WHERE room_amount = #{roomAmount} ORDER BY payment_date DESC
SELECT FROM rentpayments WHERE user_name = #{userName} ORDER BY payment_date DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rentpayments( payment_id, user_name, doc_number, room_amount, renta_mount, water_bill, electricity_bill, total_amount, payment_date, batch, payment_status, create_time, update_time ) VALUES( #{paymentId}, #{userName}, #{docNumber}, #{roomAmount}, #{rentaMount}, #{waterBill}, #{electricityBill}, #{totalAmount}, #{paymentDate}, #{batch}, #{paymentStatus}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE rentpayments SET user_name = #{userName}, doc_number = #{docNumber}, room_amount = #{roomAmount}, renta_mount = #{rentaMount}, water_bill = #{waterBill}, electricity_bill = #{electricityBill}, total_amount = #{totalAmount}, payment_date = #{paymentDate}, batch = #{batch}, payment_status = #{paymentStatus}, update_time = NOW() WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId}
mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CAST(total_amount AS SIGNED)), 0) FROM rentpayments WHERE batch = #{currentMonth} AND payment_status = '已支付'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rentpayments WHERE batch = #{currentMonth} AND payment_status = '已支付'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rentpayments WHERE batch = #{currentMonth} AND payment_status = '未支付'
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CAST(total_amount AS SIGNED)), 0) FROM rentpayments WHERE batch = #{batch} AND payment_status = '已支付'
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CAST(total_amount AS SIGNED)), 0) FROM rentpayments WHERE payment_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND payment_status = '已支付'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rentpayments WHERE payment_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND payment_status = '已支付'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rentpayments WHERE payment_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND payment_status = '未支付'

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(payment_date, '%Y-%m') as month, IFNULL(SUM(CAST(total_amount AS SIGNED)), 0) as income FROM rentpayments WHERE payment_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND payment_status = '已支付' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

SELECT room_amount as roomAmount, user_name as userName, batch, total_amount as totalAmount FROM rentpayments WHERE payment_status = '未支付' AND batch BETWEEN #{startBatch} AND #{endBatch} ORDER BY batch, room_amount

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN payment_status = '已支付' THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) as currentMonthIncome, COUNT(CASE WHEN payment_status = '已支付' THEN 1 END) as paidCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN payment_status = '未支付' THEN 1 END) as unpaidCount FROM rentpayments WHERE batch BETWEEN #{startBatch} AND #{endBatch}

SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(batch ORDER BY batch) as batchStr, GROUP_CONCAT(total_income ORDER BY batch) as incomeStr, SUM(payment_count) as paymentCount FROM ( SELECT batch, SUM(CAST(total_amount AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as total_income, COUNT(*) as payment_count FROM rentpayments WHERE payment_status = '已支付' AND batch BETWEEN #{startBatch} AND #{endBatch} GROUP BY batch ORDER BY batch ) t
